feedback: The confession follows the available evidence: Frank used the actual open preview bench, then the unattended waiting glass, and tried to substitute his approved drawing for the installed reality. His access to the bottle during the preview is newly admitted, but supplies the expected account of the crime rather than introducing a new clue needed to select him. The building-safety ending works emotionally because it returns to his professional pride and his refusal to concede the failed installation. Chip surrendering workbench keys and Brie arranging rides for her staff give the innocent suspects credible closure. The finale feels earned, although the earlier evidence supported inference more strongly than exclusive proof.
